description: Source code implementing DNS name utilities, including validation, conversion between dotted names and network wire format, and URL canonicalization, within the net::dns_names_util namespace.

methods.name: IsValidDnsName
methods.description: Checks if a DNS name in dotted form is valid.

methods.name: IsValidDnsRecordName
methods.description: Checks if a DNS record name is valid, not localhost or IP literal.

methods.name: DottedNameToNetwork
methods.description: Converts a dotted DNS name to network wire format if valid.

methods.name: NetworkToDottedName
methods.description: Converts network wire format DNS name to dotted string.

methods.name: UrlCanonicalizeNameIfAble
methods.description: Returns a canonicalized URL host name if possible.
